description: Show an actionable distinction between empty accessible journals and active filters.
steps: Open Stock Movements with an account that has no accessible journal movements
expected: The page shows an explanatory empty-state message without claiming journal records were deleted.

name: MEMS AppDeploy administrator page
description: Provide a super-administrator-only MEMS deployment launchpad.
steps: Sign in as MEMS platform super administrator
Open Platform > AppDeploy dashboard
expected: A MEMS-only read-only AppDeploy launchpad appears with working external console and app links.

name: Inspect effective access without changing existing permissions
description: Shows the current user assignments, effective permissions, duty conflict warnings, and audit review using the existing administration design.
steps: Sign in as an organization user with security-role administration permission
Open Organization administration > Security roles > Review access
Select Inspect user access and security events
Select an organization user from the list and inspect their permission sources
expected: The inspector lists only the organization's users, shows their job and direct permissions and recent security history, and provides no action that changes permissions.

name: Temporary password change is required before protected operations
description: Verifies a temporary credential must be changed through the existing flow before privileged pages or business operations are available.
steps: Sign in with a freshly issued temporary password for an organization user
Confirm the existing Set your own password screen is shown
Change the password to a new valid password
Confirm the normal organization landing page becomes available
expected: Normal business pages remain inaccessible before a verified password change; after the Firebase password update the existing landing page loads.

name: Organization logo belongs only to its own tenant
description: Check that an organization keeps its own registered or uploaded logo and cannot display a foreign tenant logo after changing accounts.
steps: Sign in as an organization super administrator and open Organization administration > Branding
Upload a valid organization logo and confirm it is shown in the branding preview and organization header
Sign out and sign in as a user of a different organization
Open the second organization's header and branding page
expected: Each organization displays only its own approved or uploaded logo (or a neutral placeholder if its stored reference is invalid). The first organization's logo never appears for the second organization.

name: Organization administrator membership limited to three
description: An existing super administrator can add or promote users up to three designated administrators and receives a clear error at the limit.
steps: Sign in as an organization super administrator and open Organization administration > Users
Review the administrator counter and select Add administrator while a slot is available
Create an administrator with a valid company email and strong temporary password
Open another existing user and attempt to assign administrator rights after three designated administrators exist
expected: The newly created administrator appears in the user list, the count does not exceed 3/3, and a fourth administrator assignment is rejected without changing user permissions.

name: Remove administrator rights without removing the account
description: An administrator can safely demote another administrator while retaining the account, and cannot remove the last active administrator.
steps: Sign in as an organization super administrator and open Organization administration > Users on a phone
Open another administrator and choose Remove administrator rights, then save the role change
Confirm the user remains listed with standard security role
Attempt to remove administrator rights when only one active administrator remains
expected: The demoted user remains an organization member, their elevated rights no longer apply, and the last active administrator cannot be removed or disabled.

name: Founder account remains permanent super administrator
description: Creator of an organization cannot be deleted, disabled or demoted while other super administrators remain editable.
steps: Sign in as a different organization super administrator and open Organization administration > Users
Open the original organization creator
Verify the creator is labeled Protected and their role and active status cannot be changed
Verify Delete is unavailable for the creator
Open a nonfounder administrator and confirm the ordinary removal-of-rights option remains available
expected: The original creator retains active super-admin status, even if other administrators exist, while other administrators can still be managed normally.

name: Personal setup persists and restores last page
description: Individual user can choose any corporate theme preset, including dark choices, and resume the last organization page.

Select Royal blue or another organization preset, and Last visited page, then save
Confirm the selected neutral colors apply while the organization's main brand color remains unchanged
Navigate to a permitted organization page and log out
Sign back in and verify the previous page is restored
Open My setup and confirm the saved choices persist
expected: The selected neutral color scheme and startup page persist only for that user, and the restored page is accessible and within the organization.

Open Organization administration > Users and scroll

expected: The fixed footer remains visible on both organization workspaces with the small MEMS platform logo and publisher text, and does not cover page controls.

name: Personal screen-time tracker with enforced breaks
description: Enable individual MEMS wellbeing breaks, track active foreground usage, and enforce a timed server-backed lock.

Enable screen-time tracking and mandatory breaks, select 15 minutes work and a 1-minute break, and save
Actively use MEMS until the chosen duration is reached
Verify an automatic logout and a timed MEMS rest message appear
Attempt login before the break ends, then again after it expires
expected: Foreground active usage is counted, the configured break triggers a server-enforced lock with remaining time, and MEMS access resumes only after the timer expires.

name: Weekly Off reactivation requires explicit account confirmation

Tick Enable my Weekly Off lockout, confirm its impact and save the setup
Confirm the selected weekday is now enforced on that user account only
expected: Existing archived weekly selections remain inert until explicitly reactivated, while users can re-enable the full-day rest lockout for their own accounts.

name: Another organization user can sign in during someone else's wellbeing lock
description: Health lockout applies to one user identity, not a device, login form, organization or platform-wide session. Clear another user's countdown and login warning when switching accounts.

Confirm A's countdown and warning are not shown for B and user B can sign in normally
Check B's session remains open while A's break timer is still running
expected: The account-specific countdown prevents only A from signing in during A's break; user B is not blocked or automatically logged out by A's lock event.

name: Weekly Off timer and other-user sign-in remain account specific
description: A weekly rest day blocks only the account that knowingly enabled it, with a visible countdown and working account switch on a shared device.
covers: weekly server lockout via session and guards

Confirm MEMS signs user A out and shows a per-user countdown to next midnight when A's email is entered
Choose Sign in with another account and authenticate user B during A's Weekly Off
Confirm B is able to enter MEMS and use authorized organization modules without A's countdown or logout
Confirm a legacy countdown stored before this reactivation does not block a different user or an inactive account
expected: Only an account that newly enabled Weekly Off is denied access on its chosen weekday, until local midnight; colleagues can log in normally.
